name: aseoescolar-pro
description: AseoEscolar Pro - Gestión de aseo escolar

scripts.install:native: npm --prefix native install && npm --prefix native run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev:electron --workspace=client"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run install:native
